help.title: How the catalog works
help.families: Russian First is tuned for Russian speech. Code Switch is tuned for Russian mixed with English technical terms. RuEn is the general Russian/English multilingual Whisper family.
help.weights: Light, Medium and Heavy describe disk and memory cost. MLX / FP16 uses Metal on Apple Silicon; CTranslate2 Int8 runs efficiently on CPU, while Int8 / Float16 targets CUDA. Nothing downloads until you press Download.
help.updates: Scan Hugging Face accepts only compatible CTranslate2 repositories with a usable model.bin and never replaces the current model automatically.

settings.appIconHint: Independent from the interface theme and applied immediately.

settings.localHint: Audio is processed locally by the current Whisper model.
settings.credentialNote: API keys go directly to the Rust process and are saved in the operating-system credential store. Saved values are never returned to the WebView.
settings.historyHint: Optionally keep successful dictations as text on this device.
settings.saveHistoryHint: Off by default. No audio is stored. Turning this off keeps existing entries until you delete them.

dictionary.title: Dictionary
dictionary.subtitle: Teach HotYap your words. Keep each project in its own context.
dictionary.learningHint: Short edits you save in the transcript editor can become new replacements. Other apps are never monitored.
dictionary.projectHint: These terms work alongside your personal dictionary when this project is active.
dictionary.personalHint: Your names, technical terms and replacements, available in every project.
dictionary.deleteProjectHint: Remove this dictionary and its entries? Files in the project folder stay untouched.
dictionary.scanHint: Scanned {{count}} source files locally. Select the names worth remembering. Only approved terms become recognition hints.
dictionary.scanLimited: Scan limit reached; results are partial.
dictionary.entryHint: Leave “When I say” empty to add a recognition hint. Replacements match whole words; project rules take priority.
dictionary.noSuggestionsHint: Edit a word in your last transcript and save. HotYap will suggest a replacement for this dictionary.
dictionary.emptyHint: Add a name, a technical term or a phrase that HotYap should spell your way.
dictionary.local: Stored locally. Approved terms may appear in processed transcripts.
dictionary.correctionHint: Short word corrections follow your dictionary learning setting.

dictationFlow.title: Dictation & delivery
dictationFlow.subtitle: Preview your words as you speak and choose where the result goes.
dictationFlow.liveHint: Shows a local-model draft while recording. Wording may change. The finalization mode below controls speed and punctuation handling. Only the final text is copied; AI text processing runs once at the end.
dictationFlow.localOnly: Your current cloud provider is processed after recording. This setting applies to local models.
dictationFlow.pasteHint: After a global dictation, send the final text to the same foreground window. If focus changes or access is blocked, keep it in the clipboard. Never presses Enter.
dictationFlow.terminalHint: Choose Ctrl+Shift+V for terminals that use it. This shortcut applies to every target app. macOS uses Command+V.
dictationFlow.provisional: Final wording and punctuation are prepared when you finish.
dictationFlow.pastedHint: Final text is also in your clipboard

platform.windows: Windows: cannot paste into applications running with higher privileges. The foreground window and focused control are checked.
platform.accessibility: macOS: allow HotYap in Accessibility and, if requested, Automation → System Events. The original window is checked; keep the same text field focused.
platform.x11: Linux X11: requires xdotool and a working global shortcut. The foreground window and focused control are checked.
platform.wayland: Wayland: automatic paste is unavailable. Use manual paste; global shortcuts may also be unavailable on your desktop.
platform.xdotool: Linux X11: install xdotool to enable automatic paste. Until then, use manual paste.
platform.unsupported: Automatic paste support could not be confirmed on this desktop.

dictationFlow.accurateHint: Transcribes the full recording again with complete phrase context. Better for punctuation, but does not reduce the wait after recording.
dictationFlow.fastHint: Reuses phrases processed at pauses and transcribes only the remainder. Punctuation can differ at phrase boundaries.
dictationFlow.showPreviewHint: Show provisional text in the app and dictation overlay. Processing during speech continues when hidden. Punctuation may change after finalization.

audioSettings.title: Microphone & sound
audioSettings.subtitle: Choose your input and keep distractions out of dictation.
audioSettings.fixedHint: Always use this microphone. If it is disconnected, recording will ask you to select another input.
audioSettings.defaultHint: Current system input: {{name}}. Follows the system default when each recording starts.
audioSettings.missingHint: This microphone is unavailable. Reconnect it or select the system default.
audioSettings.testHint: Speak for up to 15 seconds. Audio stays in memory, is not transcribed, and is discarded after the test.
audioSettings.speak: Speak normally and watch the signal
audioSettings.detected: Signal detected · microphone is receiving sound
audioSettings.silent: No clear signal detected. Check the selected input, its volume and microphone permission.
audioSettings.outputHint: Applies to output sound only. Lowering uses 20% of the current volume. The previous level is restored when recording ends; manual changes are respected.
audioSettings.outputCompatibility: Windows and macOS use native audio controls. Linux requires pactl with PulseAudio or PipeWire. Some external outputs do not allow software volume control.
audioSettings.applicationHint: Choose how HotYap fits into your desktop.
audioSettings.startupHint: Start HotYap when you sign in. Applied when you save settings.
audioSettings.trayHint: The close button hides HotYap. Dictation shortcuts remain available. Use Quit in the tray menu to exit.
audioSettings.quitHint: The close button quits HotYap. Any recording or transcription in progress will be stopped.
